邮局逻辑已核对：群消息完成成员同步尝试后，仍会尝试向允许使用的邮局保存副本，没有“已有一个成员副本就跳过邮局”的判断。刚运行的三节点回归也通过了：先只有一份成员副本，恢复连接并重启发送端后能补到两份。但这还不能确定截图中是哪位成员缺少确认。

**“1 份副本”可以暂时正常，但三名独立账号长期在线、都开启副本共享时，一直只有 1 份就值得继续查。已有成员副本也不会直接阻止邮局存储。**

截图里的两个数字含义不同：

- **3 known online**：本机所知的在线成员账号数，包含你自己；不保证每个人的消息同步都成功。
- **1 member copy**：除你自己的账号外，已有 **1 个成员账号确认持久保存这条消息**。自己的关联设备不计数，也不是已读人数。

当前代码中，三人小群会向其他成员尝试同步；后台目标是最多 **2 个其他成员账号的副本**。因此，长期只有 1 份可能涉及另一成员关闭副本共享、连接或同步失败、客户端协议兼容问题，或确认信息尚未同步到当前设备。**截图不足以区分这些原因，也不能证明另一个人没收到消息。** [计数与补副本逻辑](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/crates/mesh-talk-core/src/node/channels.rs:3858)

关于你说的“邮箱”（邮局）：**群消息在尝试成员同步后，仍会尝试邮局存储，并不以成员副本数为零作为条件。** 但需要有可用邮局、允许向它发送，且实际存储成功；邮局副本单独用收件箱图标表示，不计入成员副本。[发送逻辑](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/crates/mesh-talk-core/src/node/channels.rs:3191)

我运行了相关三节点回归：模拟第三人离线时显示 1 份，随后恢复连接并重启发送端，成功补到 2 份，测试通过。没有修改代码。

**目前确认了规则，尚未定位截图这次的实际原因。** 本地 agent API 不提供消息历史或成员副本诊断；进一步定位需要截图对应客户端的版本、相关时间段日志，以及另一成员的副本共享设置。

Better: “Why does this group message consistently show only one confirmed member copy?”  
Why: “confirmed copy” 明确指已确认保存的副本，避免与复制操作混淆。  
Pattern: “Does an existing member copy prevent post-office replication?”  
Collocations: confirmed copy, durable storage, replication failure  
IPA: replica /ˈrɛplɪkə/

 Replica custody counts and exact-have checks are historical copy evidence. They are not a lease guaranteeing a holder will remain online forever, a human read receipt, or proof that every group destination received the event.
+
+Message-confirming fanout preserves the actual synchronization error for the
+existing coalesced group-control retry owner. An authenticated connection that
+closes, a stale source, capacity deferral or an incomplete round is not a successful
+fanout. A `NoProgress` result can coexist with possession of the selected message:
+retire the failed connection and reception admission, then make one independent
+exact-have check over a usable pinned connection inside the original peer deadline.
+Never continue the partially consumed protocol connection after an error.
+A positive exact answer updates member-copy evidence without declaring all
+group controls synchronized. The same bounded per-group revision remains subject
+to its existing one-to-300-second failure backoff; no per-message retry queue is
+added. A negative or unavailable answer cannot produce a confirmed copy.
*** Update File: /Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/docs/ai-coding-reliability.md
@@
 additive internal observation, and keep delivery/custody proof independent. The
 same profile publisher controls exercise warm relay publication with unavailable
 direct delivery; mailbox controls retain source-change and relay-reset recovery.
+Do not discard a sync error while returning a successful byte count to the
+distribution owner. Whole-history `NoProgress` can coexist with an exact retained
+message. Preserve the failed control revision and its existing backoff while a
+fresh authenticated exact-have query independently qualifies that copy within the
+original deadline. Retire the old protocol connection and actual reception
+admission before redialing. The [confirming-fanout regression](../crates/mesh-talk-core/src/node/channels.rs)
+and [exact-custody failure-path regressions](../crates/mesh-talk-core/src/node/session/paged_tests.rs)
+exercise authenticated closure, incomplete reconciliation and positive/negative
+answers on the replacement connection.
*** End Patch"));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > ../../tmp/reception-source-pr/media-send-transitions-plan.md <<'EOF'
# Media send transitions implementation plan

Goal: Replace the recorded fallback-emoji/loading/waiting jumps with stable artwork, a single quiet transfer state and short truthful transitions.

Architecture: Keep protocol and receipt authorities unchanged. An owner-scoped bounded outgoing-preview store supplies only locally captured ordinary image/sticker bytes to visible outgoing rows by their existing clientId. Media components retain their geometry and fade from that temporary preview to the durable decoded source; generic attachments use their existing secondary line for status. Existing transfer observations drive percentages.

Stack: React, Zustand, the current media cache/hooks, CSS opacity/transform transitions and existing Framer Motion/ease tokens.

## Ownership and limits

- The pending send intent is the preview producer. No persisted history, transport payload or protected media contains preview bytes or URLs.
- At most eight previews, three MiB each and twelve MiB combined. Eviction revokes URLs and publishes a bounded presentation change. One expiry owner reclaims previews after thirty seconds; canonical image load releases sooner. Empty cache has no timer. Lock, startup/runtime replacement and current-owner stop clear synchronously.
- Existing clientId survives canonical acceptance. Component reads check the current owner predicate; receiving history never substitutes installed pack art for received bytes.
- No added native reads, polling or fabricated transfer progress. Unknown progress stays indeterminate. Existing 100ms measured progress, 180ms content opacity and 80ms reduced-motion opacity are retained; no idle/hidden decorative loop.

## Task 1: bounded previews

Files: frontend/src/store/outgoingMediaPreviews.ts and its inline-near test file; frontend/src/store/outgoingIntent.ts; frontend/src/store/chat.ts; frontend/src/store/conversationModel.ts; attachment intake.

1. Add failing tests for budget eviction/revocation, stale owners, expiry, reset and immutable source handoff.
2. Implement retain/release/reset and a per-key subscription with explicit byte accounting and one next-expiry timer.
3. Let beginSendIntent accept an ephemeral Blob option; exclude protected sends. Capture sticker bytes and eligible clipboard image bytes before their source retires. Do not retain the Blob in SendPayload or ChatMessage.
4. Clear at existing chat reset/start/current-owner stop boundaries; bind producer cancellation and deleted/expired rows to release where their owner already has clientId.
5. Run the preview and outgoing/session lifecycle tests, including protected-send rejection and account replacement.

## Task 2: stable media reveal

Files: MediaSticker.tsx, MediaPreview.tsx, MessageBubble.tsx, matching component tests and index.css.

1. Add failing controls for preview-to-durable transition, late image callbacks, decode failure/retry, missing bytes, read-only history and owner retirement.
2. Use a fixed 128px sticker stage. Keep the captured preview while the exact durable URL decodes, fade the durable pixels in over 180ms, then release the preview. Keep failures actionable and preserve accessible names.
3. Allow ordinary inline image placeholders during local staging so they do not first render as generic file cards. Carry the captured preview through canonical acceptance without granting availability, download or receipt state.
4. Respect current geometry limits, generation guards and reduced motion. Do not animate history entry or video controls.

## Task 3: one quiet transfer surface

Files: TransferBar.tsx, MessageBubble.tsx, TransferBar.test.ts and index.css.

1. Keep existing numeric/unknown/confirmation/consent regressions red-capable; add compact and media-overlay controls.
2. Add compact file-card and media-overlay presentations using the same observer and phase labels. The idle file size occupies the same reserved secondary line. Hide duplicate preparation/waiting lines, preserve full accessible state and confirmed-progress semantics.
3. Interpolate measured transforms with the current 100ms linear rule. Use short opacity transitions for phase/reveal and no indeterminate decorative loop.

## Task 4: acceptance

Files: file-send-progress.spec.ts and/or existing sticker/media lifecycle specs; owning validation contracts and portable browser inventory; frontend/DESIGN.md and reliability/performance owners only for durable rules.

1. Exercise delayed staging, delayed file availability, late decode, failed/retried sends, rapid multiple sends, read-only/incoming history, owner replacement and reduced motion.
2. Register every portable browser case in scripts/evals/browser-report.mjs and update its strict inventory tests in the same change.
3. Run affected units, the portable discovery diagnostic, send-progress/media lifecycle browser cases and visual regression. Perform one batched desktop/narrow/reduced-motion capture; fix all observed issues once and confirm once.
4. Run final formatting/lint/types/build/verified patch coverage and standards/hygiene checks. Publish an animation PR after the independent custody PR is green/merged; rebase this task-owned branch onto that verified main without carrying duplicate base commits.

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > tmp/reception-source-pr/media-motion-pr-body.md <<'EOF'
Outgoing stickers and images briefly replaced selected artwork with fallback emoji, loading text and receiving placeholders while file metadata and decoded pixels became ready. Preserve the exact selected artwork through that handoff, keep a stable media stage, and present one restrained transfer surface: a secondary line for files and an inset capsule for photos/stickers.

Local previews are presentation only. They never establish file availability, delivery or custody. Existing measured percentages, ETA, approval, confirmation pending, failure/Retry and reduced-motion behavior remain intact. Static staged photos pass bounded PNG/JPEG header geometry inspection before an original preview URL is created; unknown or oversized dimensions retain the preparing stage. Pack validation shares the existing header parser.

Preview ownership follows the original chat account/runtime and logical message clientId.
